name: Rocket.Chat
description: Team chat with channels, direct messages and integrations. Follows the official rocketchat-compose architecture: Rocket.Chat, MongoDB (single-member replica set) and NATS; monitoring left out.
license: MIT (enterprise features under a separate licence)

mongodb-fix-permission.label: MongoDB permissions
mongodb-fix-permission.purpose: Gives the MongoDB data volume to the database user (uid 1001) before MongoDB starts, then exits.
entrypoint: owner="$$(stat -c %u /data/db)"; if [ "$$owner" != "$$MONGODB_USER_ID" ]; then echo "=====> Fixing directory ownership to uid $$MONGODB_USER_ID"; chown -R "$$MONGODB_USER_ID" /data/db; else echo "=====> Nothing to do"; fi

mongodb.label: MongoDB
entrypoint: for i in $$(seq 1 60); do owner="$$(stat -c %u /data/db 2>/dev/null || true)"; if [ "$$owner" = "$$MONGODB_USER_ID" ]; then exec mongod --replSet "$$MONGODB_REPLICA_SET_NAME" --bind_ip_all; fi; echo "=====> waiting for /data/db ownership"; sleep 5; done; exit 1

mongodb-init.label: MongoDB replica-set initialization
mongodb-init.purpose: Initializes the single-member replica set rs0 that Rocket.Chat requires (once), then exits.
entrypoint: until mongosh "$$MONGODB_URI" --eval "db.adminCommand('ping')" >/dev/null 2>&1; do echo waiting; sleep 5; done; mongosh "$$MONGODB_URI" --eval "try { rs.status() } catch (e) { rs.initiate({_id: '$$MONGODB_REPLICA_SET_NAME', members: [{ _id: 0, host: '$$MONGODB_ADVERTISED_HOSTNAME:$$MONGODB_PORT_NUMBER' }]}) }"

nats.label: NATS
nats.purpose: Message bus between Rocket.Chat processes. Its image has no health check.

security: MongoDB runs without authentication like the official compose, but only on the app's private network; it is never published.
Create the administrator account in the setup wizard right after the first start.
Set ROOT_URL (in .env) to the public address after publishing.

notes: Desktop and mobile clients and federation use their own authentication; ForwardAuth blocks them. Use Rocket.Chat's custom OAuth with authentik instead.
WebSockets are required (Traefik passes them through).

limitations: MongoDB runs as a single-node replica set (no high availability).
Mobile push notifications need a Rocket.Chat Cloud registration.

update.notes: MongoDB major upgrades follow Rocket.Chat's documented procedure; Rocket.Chat 8.x needs MongoDB 8.0 or later.
